findings.title: [P2] Keep versions.mjs Kubernetes and Argo outputs classified as API
findings.body: Source `scripts/versions.mjs`: renewing this receipt authorizes every `fs.writeFileSync(..., content)` in `syncVersions` as non-API, but `bindInfrastructureVersions` puts complete API documents into that output map. Examples include `gitops/platform/bootstrap/spire.yaml` (Argo Application) and `gitops/platform/litellm/resources.yaml` (Kubernetes Deployment). These are deployment inputs: `gitops/platform/platform.yaml` selects the bootstrap directory, and the registry-mirror manifest is consumed by `kubectl apply` in `scripts/deploy.sh`. The classifier accepts this contract before resolving the actual output, so the refreshed digest suppresses API classification for known API roots. Split native artifacts from API documents and supply discovery/adapters for the latter before renewing this receipt. `scripts/updates/refresh-versions.mjs` also reaches this writer through `syncVersions(root, false)`; its native status and rollback receipts do not close that downstream API boundary.

overall_explanation:
Partition 2/8 Source/native-consumer decisions:
PASS scripts/check-configuration-drift-mutations.mjs: selected writes mutate and restore isolated copied sources; consumers are inventory/publication assertions. Forwarded stdout comes from selected generator check branches emitting status text. Failure paths restore or remove the temporary tree. Copied repository bytes, inherited environment, dependencies and child execution remain runtime inputs, not qualified by this classification.
NOT_READY scripts/versions.mjs: native Dockerfile/config/code artifacts share the selected content sink with complete Kubernetes and Argo API documents. Their API output discovery/adapter closure is unproven; see finding.
NOT_READY scripts/updates/refresh-versions.mjs: selected progress text and versions.json rollback are native, but whole selected Source closure reaches the unqualified API writes in syncVersions. Upstream registry/release responses, checkout/HEAD, credentials and lock-update effects are additional inputs/effects; receipt syntax does not qualify them.
PASS scripts/retire-nova-dispatch.mjs: bounded scope input reaches validated intent and retained run/import/dispatch authority; success returns fixed compaction-result fields and a native projection receipt. Conflicts and failures reject or emit a bounded error code. Mutable journals/stores remain required runtime authority.
PASS scripts/ap08-review-scope.mjs: selected outputs report counts/path for a locally generated review allowlist, consumed by byte comparison and read-only review instructions. Directory membership and document links are mutable inputs; no API submission occurs.
PASS scripts/generate-operator-task-registry.mjs: selected outputs report native registry generation/check status; authored task data and implementation-derived recovery outcomes feed a documentation inventory checked for equality. Assertions stop publication on mismatch.
PASS skills/nova/project/cli.ts: selected file is a compiled pipeline-definition.v2 graph, validated against contracts and installed runtime before exclusive publication; core CLI loads it as a pipeline definition. Argument, compilation and runtime-validation failures emit errors instead. Project/platform files, installed packages and recovery snapshots remain runtime inputs.
Scope: listed receipt renewals and selected caller/input/publication/consumer closure only. No execution, edits, broad registry/gate acceptance, communication or host-lifecycle review.
